text:
Seth Jones has 21 points in 19 games, playing almost 25 minutes a night, and one Panthers blog is already making his Norris case. Fourteen of those points are on the power play, where Florida has leaned on him with Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand out.

The pace is ahead of what we'd expect (2.68 points per 60 against a range topping out near 2.1), and that's the honest caveat: power-play points come in bunches and leave the same way. His own shooting is normal. After a foot injury cost him much of last season, though, simply being this central is the story.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows both sides of him: he stops 18% of the entries aimed at him (typical is 11%) and carries the puck in often, but only 30% of his exits keep possession, so watch for clears off the glass under pressure. Our range has him at 56 to 81 points.
